text.zh_cn:
# 出发之前
不死人从不空手踏上旅途。
- 穿好护甲，哪怕只是 [item:minecraft:leather_helmet]
- 火把是黑暗中最廉价的光：[item:minecraft:torch]
- 备好 [item:minecraft:bread]，饥饿比怪物更致命
text.en_us:
# Before Departure
The undead never travel empty-handed.
- Wear armor, even just a [item:minecraft:leather_helmet]
- A torch is the cheapest light in the dark: [item:minecraft:torch]
- Bring [item:minecraft:bread]; hunger kills more than monsters

text.zh_cn:
# 标记之路
迷路的代价，是重走一遍地狱。
- 记住你的坐标（F3），或写下路标
- 用 [item:minecraft:compass] 与 [item:minecraft:map] 规划归途
- 在岔路口放置火把，黑暗会记住你的方向
> 路标，是献给未来自己的遗言。
text.en_us:
# Roads Marked
Getting lost means walking hell again.
- Note your coordinates (F3) or write landmarks
- Plan returns with [item:minecraft:compass] and [item:minecraft:map]
- Leave torches at forks; the dark remembers your path
> A landmark is a will left for your future self.

text.zh_cn:
# 剑的节奏
战斗中，急躁是最大的破绽。
- 攻击冷却条回满时出手，伤害最高
- 盾牌格挡可化解多数攻击：[item:minecraft:shield]
- 面对群敌，退入狭窄通道逐一击破
> 犹豫，就会败北。
text.en_us:
# Rhythm of the Blade
In battle, impatience is the greatest flaw.
- Strike when the attack cooldown is full for max damage
- Block most blows with [item:minecraft:shield]
- Against crowds, funnel them through narrow passages
> Hesitation is defeat.

text.zh_cn:
# 死亡之后
死，不过是归途的一站。
- 死亡掉落物品与经验，请捡回你的魂
- [item:minecraft:totem_of_undying] 可免死一次
- 服用 [effect:minecraft:regeneration] 药水可更快恢复
> 薪火未熄，人便不死。
text.en_us:
# After Death
Death is but one stop on the road home.
- Dying drops items and experience; reclaim your souls
- [item:minecraft:totem_of_undying] saves you once
- Drink a [effect:minecraft:regeneration] potion to recover faster
> While the flame lingers, you cannot truly die.
